qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Closed-book life and pension consolidator with locked-in long-duration regulatory books, but statutory IFRS returns fail the 12% ROIC/ROE threshold and bulk purchase annuity deals are competitive spread-based auctions lacking pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). UK closed-book life and pension consolidator with bulk purchase annuity operations. Capital is locked in regulatory matching assets with volatile statutory returns failing the 12% hurdle and zero pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year statutory IFRS earnings are volatile and frequently negative (-£1.08B statutory loss in FY24, net loss in FY22) due to interest-rate hedging variances and asset-liability discounting. While operating cash generation is steady, BPA deals are price-competitive auctions against Legal & General and Rothesay, and run-off closed books lack secular organic growth or pricing power >= inflation.
